title: Focused scalar IN lowering expands large explicit collections linearly.

proposal_metadata.scope: Route stages containing large explicit scalar IN collections through existing full physical peephole before focused lowering creates a linear comparison chain.
validation_required: Independent ANSI/legacy truth tables across homogeneous/heterogeneous scalar tuples/lists, NULL and failed conversions
Empty/tiny collections stay on focused path; threshold boundary cases
Plan dictionary construction/Contains and absence of list-sized comparison OR
Invariant collection construction must not depend on row arguments; row-dependent collections must retain dependencies
Measure runtime lookup CPU, plan size, compile cost and peak memory separately
proposal_metadata.scope_note: Uses existing full-stage lowering rather than duplicating null/cast rules; compilation footprint may increase for qualifying stages.
integration_overlap: C43 has a separate post-focused fallback; preserve both predicates without broadening this trigger
proposal_metadata.independent_source_review: No additional source blocker after review; native/build and stated topology checks remain required.

verification_limitation: Source preparation only; compilation, native semantics and optimization evidence still required.
